C1644.title: Meta-Guardian: An On-device Application to Mitigate Psychography Data Leakage in Immersive Technologies
C1644.summary: This study evaluates the leakage risks of facial and eye-tracking data streams in immersive technologies, highlighting that personal physiological data can be exposed to the Internet of Everything. It develops an on-device application to mitigate psychography data leakage.

references.title: Meta-Guardian: An Early Evaluation of an On-Device Application to Mitigate Psychography Data Leakage in Immersive Technologies
